source.name: Global Forest Watch integrated deforestation alerts
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (GFW integrated deforestation alerts; dataset metadata licence)
source.note: Weekly sums of GLAD-L, GLAD-S2 and RADD alerts (medium + high confidence) per country; density = alert area per 10,000 km² of the country. Alerts flag likely tree-cover disturbance, not confirmed deforestation.
